violations.text: An open employees' beverage container was observed stored in a food preparation area. Employees shall not drink from open beverage containers in order to prevent contamination of their hands, the container, and exposed food. Lids were provided during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

An employee was observed touching ready to eat food (cut melon) with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. Food item was voluntarily disposed of during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

The 3-door sliding unit was observed held at an ambient temperature of 57 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items within the unit were evaluated and moved or voluntarily disposed of during the time of inspection. Establishment is not to use unit to hold TCS food items until unit is repaired, replaced, or removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in cooler fan guards have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (deli slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Deli slicer was disassembled, cleaned, and sanitized during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2025

Mahi filet was observed thawing in the walk-in cooler with intact reduced oxygen packaging (ROP). Seafood food items shall be removed from their original packaging prior to thawing to allow the reintroduction of oxygen into the food item. Food items were observed at temperatures ranging from 28-32 degrees Fahrenheit and were removed from their original packaging during the time of inspection. Proper thawing methods discussed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2025
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on prep unit #1. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/03/2025
